Matovu et al., 2008: The study has a serious risk of bias as it included only HIV-positive women who were already adhering to exclusive breastfeeding (EBF), which introduces selection bias and may influence the findings. 35. Tomlinson et al., 2014: The study has serious indirectness as the sample population included both HIV-positive and HIV-negative women (30% HIV-positive).
